affordable_home_ac.author: Bryan M.
affordable_home_ac.text:
I found this company on Google. They are located in the Waipahu industrial area across from the old City Mill. The LG AC unit my mother needed was in stock - so that was a HUGE plus. However, she left 3 messages for them during the day on a Friday (May 1st). Brian called her Saturday morning and my mother went to their warehouse that morning and picked up an upgraded LG AC unit (more energy efficient & way more quiet) that was installed yesterday (May 3rd).

Yes, we wish they returned her call sooner, but they were likely very busy and/or short staffed. Also, their website has been down since May 1st. Not sure why that is, but tried to visit their website again this morning (May 4th) and it's still down. Hope they get that resolved soon.

Overall, we'd recommend Affordable Home AC in Waipahu, and in particular Brian. Brian was cordial; he said and did all the right things. Thank you again, Brian!

affordable_home_ac.author: Tommylynn B.
affordable_home_ac.text: I replaced two window ac units, called on Wednesday and Brian came out the next day. Professional, timely and installation was flawless! Mahalo Brian!

affordable_home_ac.author: Ron T.
affordable_home_ac.text:
Very efficient and worked on a holiday (Veterans Day) to replace my large window AC. My AC also has WiFi so I can control it outside my home. Chris was very professional and was teaching his coworkers the tips and tricks on a successful installation.

Chris installed a total of 2 ACs in my place. They are busy but they will stick to their schedule! Thank you guys for installing my ACs!!!

They also do maintenance on the units!

affordable_home_ac.author: Adrienne L.
affordable_home_ac.text:
We had gotten our window unit initially installed by Affordable Home AC a year ago. We noticed our unit started leaking onto the Lanai, and called them up to take a look at the issue. They were able to give us a quote on the phone, and schedule within 2 days.

Chris came onsite, remembered us, and was able to remove, assess the issue, and correct the unit within an hour and a half. We also asked him what best practices were to maintain our unit to maximize it's lifecycle. He was honest, and gave us things we should do weekly ourselves (checking the filter to clean) and scheduling maintenance just short of yearly. As people who aren't familiar with AC systems, he's extremely knowledgable, has great bedside manners, and is a really honest guy who isn't money grabbing at every opportunity.

We plan to reach out for future services and any other AC needs we will have in the future!

affordable_home_ac.author: Samuel L.
affordable_home_ac.text:

Now my A/C runs like it's new again! Great!
In the future, I'm not going to wait until my A/C unit starts to run sluggish again.
Affordable Home A/C & Window
A/C Cleaning Services! Mahalo!

Bryan M.

affordable_home_ac.author: Tim B.

My home office is much cooler and quieter now. Mahalo to Brian and his team for their excellent service. If you need help with your AC, give Brian a call at 808-488-1111 today. You'll be glad you did!

affordable_home_ac.author: Audrie O.
affordable_home_ac.text: Chris was great. He got back with me very quickly with the quote for cleaning. And then he was right on time coming for the job. We were very satisfied with the job they did and will definitely be using their services in the near future! I would definitely recommend using them!

affordable_home_ac.author: Jen K.
affordable_home_ac.text: Great service. Received an LG ac for condo and the team was efficient, professional and did a really nice job. Good quality, quiet ac.

affordable_home_ac.author: Miss L.
affordable_home_ac.text: Affordable Home AC did an excellent job in installing a new window unit air conditioner and removing and replacing two other window units. They do beautiful work. Thank you Brian, Chris and Omar!

affordable_home_ac.author: Carrie N.

Friendly and prompt customer service! Took the time to explain how to install unit and had a rebate application printed out for me on pick up (with necessary info filled out). Very prifessional, thorough and organized operation.

affordable_home_ac.author: Jojo G.
affordable_home_ac.text:
Highly recommend to anyone needing AC services. Very accommodating, great customer service and does excellent work!!

Aron N.

affordable_home_ac.text:

I will sure recommend them to friend and family

Brian and Team
Affordable Home AC

affordable_home_ac.author: Nella I.
affordable_home_ac.text:
Brian and his team are AMAZING! This review is long overdue but so happy I can finally take the time to review them.

I reached out to Brian for a quote last summer after having my baby. Our apartment is a common place where his team provides service so I was pleased that they were familiar with our paperwork we had to provide to our HOA and complex site managers. Brian provided a free estimate after a walk through of our home. He gave a thorough breakdown and wasn't pushing for a sale at all - simply stated to give him a call whenever we're ready. Prices were way better than other places we checked.

He makes it easy to communicate with him and the team through text messaging. The crew that installed everything were fast and efficient. Everything was pretty much done in an hour or so! This entire team is personable, friendly and definitely can tell they are family oriented as they were waving to baby each time they passed by.

Brian even checked on our experience shortly after they left and wished us well wishes with our newborn. Thank you for this great experience!

affordable_home_ac.author: Mark D.
affordable_home_ac.text: Thrilled with the work completed by Affordable Home AC. They did a great job with a tricky replacement project for 3 in-wall AC units. From initial contact to final install was about 1.5 weeks. This included talking to Brian via the phone to see if the project was something they would do, Brian coming out to do an inspection/estimate, and finally the installation day. Couldn't ask for better! The three new LG units work well, are quiet, and were really cleanly installed. Mahalo Brian and team. Strongly recommended!

affordable_home_ac.author: Mark E.
affordable_home_ac.text:
I had Affordable Home AC install a new through-the-wall air conditioner in my apartment. They did a great job. I quickly made arrangements with Brian, and the installers Chris and Makua (sorry if I spelled the name wrong) arrived at the appointed time and very efficiently removed and hauled away the old A.C., installed the new one, showed me how to use it, and cleaned up. The new A.C. works really well.
Excellent service.

affordable_home_ac.author: Glenn ..
affordable_home_ac.text: I needed to change my existing thru-the wall unit and after calling numerous companies and being told they do only split systems or central systems I was beginning to get discouraged. I decided to give Affordable Home AC a call. After leaving a message, Brian returned my call very promptly. He told me yes they do sell and install wall units. What a Godsend! He gave me a very reasonable quote and informed me the they could schedule the work the very next week. On the day of the installation they called and showed up earlier than expected. They promptly went to work in removing the old unit and installing the new one in about 1/2 hour. As a retired construction inspector, I've worked with numerous contractors before and I can tell you these guys are the real deal! They were fast, efficient and very neat. Brian and Chris took the time to explain how to operate the unit and how to fill out the rebate form. This company is no shibai and will not jerk you around. By the way the LG unit they installed is very highly rated. I will highly recommend this company. Try giving them a call first you won't be disapointed.

affordable_home_ac.author: James C.
affordable_home_ac.text: Quality work, LG 14000 btu window AC is super quiet. I highly recommend these guys. They are the window AC guys to call. Mahalo nui loa

affordable_home_ac.author: Reid H.
affordable_home_ac.text:
So glad I found Affordable Home AC! I needed to find a company that could install a window a/c unit, and they're one of the few that can. I reached out on Wednesday, September 6th, to multiple companies via Yelp's "Projects" feature, and received a response from Bryan M the next day at 10:00 am - his response had estimates for the unit + installation, which I appreciated!

I called in that day to discuss scheduling an appointment, and was able to schedule for today, Wednesday, Sept 13. So, complete turnaround time from my initial reach out to installation was exactly one week - awesome!

I believe I spoke with the owner, Brian, on the phone to discuss the scheduling, and he answered all my questions thoroughly and patiently. I also want to give a shout out to Chris and Makoa who did the actual installation - they finished everything, including explaining the features and educating on unit care/maintenance, in an hour, and were very courteous and professional throughout.

Overall, I highly encourage this company - I really only write reviews for very positive experiences, and the Affordable Home AC team was great to work with every step of the way!

affordable_home_ac.author: Carl N.
affordable_home_ac.text: Called for appointment and Brian promptly showed up, gave us a great in-the-wall solution at a great price. He scheduled installation a couple weeks later. Chris and assistant showed up on time, completed the job quickly, neatly, and efficiently!! Excellent people to work with. Much mahalos!!

affordable_home_ac.author: Amber C.
affordable_home_ac.text: Our family has been nothing but pleased with this company. Chris is professional and courteous. He went above and beyond to make sure our family was happy with our A/C.

affordable_home_ac.author: Jay M.
affordable_home_ac.text:
This company is definitely trustworthy and great at their jobs!
I called and left a message on their machine and they called me back the following day because they do their installations throughout the day and return late in the afternoon.
I scheduled an in home estimate with Brian and was trying to replace my living room Friedrich unit and was recommended the LG as a quieter and more energy efficient option. They returned a week later with the installation team and after an hour, they were finished. Installation looked great, everything was sealed up front and back and framed with new trim wood. The unit is sooooo much quieter than the last one and I am a happy customer with nothing but great things to say.
Thank you to Brian and Chris for your hard work and kind words

affordable_home_ac.author: Daniel S.
affordable_home_ac.text:
Brian is the real deal. Transparent with pricing, honest, and successfully replaced my AC (that was installed incorrectly from another contractor). Definitely recommend!

Sharon H.

affordable_home_ac.author: Cindy B.
affordable_home_ac.text:
Just had my 20 year ac finally replaced and I'm so sad we didn't do this sooner! We were def suffering from the heat with our ac that was so loud, not blowing cool air, and wasting so much energy. Called Affordable Home AC and spoke with Brian to schedule a free home estimate. Brian was professional, quick, and kind, he was straight to the point (no up-selling or anything) and we decided to schedule an install 2 weeks after.

I love love love my new ACs! If you need your ac replaced please check them out!

affordable_home_ac.author: Greg A.

affordable_home_ac.author: Kit Cat S.
affordable_home_ac.text: Definitely would recommend this company. Brian, Chris & Shawn, did an Awesome & fast job on installing my A/C through my wall, and replacing my old A/C unit. I'm really satisfied with their work. Mahalo Brian & crew for an outstanding job well done.

affordable_home_ac.author: Terry T.

Chris and Shawn arrived on time today and were super nice and friendly. Told me they were going to remove the old unit and close up any gaps and replace with the LG. They were done in about 45 mins and Chris gave me some advice on maintenance. This was truly a great experience and told Brian would call him when we replace the living room unit. Highly recommend this company for service and price!

Lurine J.

I also like that they haul away the old air conditioner for free. I highly recommend Affordable Home AC is you're looking to just buy a wall unit!

affordable_home_ac.author: Yvonne H.

It was installed in just under an hour, and they hauled away the old unit. I appreciated the quick tutorial on all of the features. I would definitely use them again for any a/c needs.

affordable_home_ac.author: Mark H.
affordable_home_ac.text: Our AC's were through the wall from the previous owner. If I put in a split system I would have to patch from both inside and outside the house. Better to replace! They changed out 3 units, cleaned up inside (and out) and did a great job. The new units are quieter than the previous AC's, and most importantly, my house is cool! Highly recommend if you are in a position similar to mine.

affordable_home_ac.author: Marlene N.
affordable_home_ac.text: If you need a window a/c unit, these are the guys to call. Brian came to do the consult and estimate, then Chris and Shawn came on the scheduled day and time. affordable_home_ac.author: Jan M.
affordable_home_ac.text: Omg, in and out in less than an hour!! Devin and I think Ron? Or possibly Don looking at a prior review came to do the installation. Our new ac's look beautiful, they put the painted trim back around the ac's like it was barely removed. We are very happy and will definitely call them again for our future ac needs.

affordable_home_ac.author: Daniel R.
affordable_home_ac.text: Chris has customer service second to none!!! I called for a maintenance issue after a torrential rain storm; one hour later he returned my call and came over at lunch...fixed the problem before noon. I highly recommend giving this company your business!!!

affordable_home_ac.author: Hoku T.
affordable_home_ac.text: Our units need a particular size of AC and sourcing it can be difficult. Luckily Brian was available almost immediately to install an AC and was able to let us know what we were spending our money on. Not only that, but he was kind and patient as he dealt with all of our questions involving the warranty, usage, and the product itself.

affordable_home_ac.author: Ayman E.
affordable_home_ac.text: Was looking on Yelp for someone to install a window AC in my condo and decided to give Affordable Home AC a call. Brian got back to me right away and provided an estimate soon after we spoke. Once I confirmed my interest, he set up the installation appointment and confirmed the day prior. Crew arrived on time, were very efficient and clean. Done within a couple hours including painting and caulking. Explained everything they were doing as well as the warranty and operation of the unit. I am a very happy customer and recommend them highly.

affordable_home_ac.author: Sherril H.
affordable_home_ac.text: My 15 year old rooftop AC unit finally reached the end of its life, and I called Affordable AC to get a quote. Andrew arrived quickly, looked at the A/C very quickly, and gave me the lowest quote out of the 6 different places I'd been looking at (seriously, it was about half the amount that some of the other places!). I unfortunately went with a different company that had a slightly better policy, but Affordable AC had the best price by THOUSANDS, were very courteous, and were extremely fast with their service and replies to me. I will definitely be recommending this company to friends who may need AC repairs.

affordable_home_ac.author: Randal K.
affordable_home_ac.text: Window unit installed. Owner Brian was very professional from the start. Chris an Shawn did an awesome job installing the unit. Cleaned up after their work and install looks great! Highly recommend Affordable AC!

affordable_home_ac.author: Kat N.
affordable_home_ac.text: I have been working with this company for a couple of years now, they have installed window ACs in many of the properties we manage. They are always professional, responsive and they provide an accurate quote based on the need of the room. They have also taken time to educate me on the process, and they have very reasonable rates. Customer service is wonderful. I have recommended them to my friends and family. Will continue to work with them and highly recommend to anyone!

affordable_home_ac.author: Tyrone M.
affordable_home_ac.text: I don't write many reviews. But, when I do it's because of deserving mention! I have been wanting AC in my room for quite some time. Hesitant due to me being particular, & owning an older home. A split unit would be overkill, & window unit in my jalousies would be an eye sore. So I did some research, & a decision was made. affordable_home_ac.author: Kathleen F.
affordable_home_ac.text: We dealt with a year of complications with our window unit ACs and poor installations. Brian and his staff were so helpful, responsive and literally made the whole process seamless and stress free. They did excellent work and will definitely use them again. Anyone looking to install, repair or maintain wall unit ACs - trust me don't use anyone else or you will definitely have many issues. These guys are the experts!

affordable_home_ac.author: Marian O.
affordable_home_ac.text: Wow! Great improvement - AH AC is professional, timely and fast. What a difference from your typical local vendors that don't return calls, are late if they show up at all and tell you the instructions are in the manual. Like who wants to read a manual! They explained all the features, offered maintenance and walked me thru the features. Definitely recommend!

affordable_home_ac.author: Kelli P.
affordable_home_ac.text: Brian called back promptly to schedule our initial assessment appt. That was done within a few days and then he was able to schedule the install for the following week. They explained things along the way and answered any questions we had at the end and even offered to move furniture back around if we needed the help. We're extremely satisfied and would definitely recommend them.

affordable_home_ac.author: Clara D.
affordable_home_ac.text: These guys are awesome to deal with. First off, making an appointment for an estimate...easy peasy! Called one day, Sarah came to my house the next day. Gave me the estimate, spelled everything out with no hidden "read the fine" line BS. Then for them to come out and do the install...again, easy peasy not to mention fast and clean!!! If you need a window or in wall unit, I highly recommend going with these guys hands down you will not be disappointed.

affordable_home_ac.author: Gavin C.
affordable_home_ac.text: Great job. Fast and professional. Used to replace an old window ac on a rental unit. Was able to get an estimate, schedule an appointment and pay once the installation was completed all over the phone. My tenant was pleased with their professionalism and quality

affordable_home_ac.author: Julie P.
affordable_home_ac.text: I had requested an estimate on my AC unit that needed to be replaced. I got a response a few hours later via email which I wasn't excepting a response so quick. Sarah ( Sales Rep) reached out and was able to be so flexible around what was convenient for me. She arrived on time and was very friendly throughout the whole visit. She was very knowledgeable and was very helpful with my questions. I didn't feel the pressure at all but when I finally decided to go with the work order she was able to get my AC unit replaced all in less than 24 hours!! I would definitely do business with them again.

affordable_home_ac.author: Paul S.
affordable_home_ac.text:
I needed a new window AC unit in my condo, I contacted Affordable Home AC based on the recommendation of a neighbor. I'm glad I did!
They sent out an estimator, John, who measured my condo then gave me a list of different AC units that would work in my condo. All had prices listed for both the AC unit and the labor. I made my selection and a few days later the installers came over and installed the new unit, disposed of the old unit, and cleaned the area afterwards. It all took less than an hour, they were quick and professional.
I couldn't be happier, A++ Highly recommended!

affordable_home_ac.author: Gordon L.
affordable_home_ac.text: Brian and Chris arrived on time and very professionally and quickly replaced the window air conditioner in our apartment! They were both nice guys too and Covid safety conscious. I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking to buy a new air conditioner. Mahalo!

affordable_home_ac.author: Todd N.
affordable_home_ac.text: If you are looking for a professionally installed window ac unit, look no further than Affordable Home AC. The people I had the pleasure of dealing with were top notch. Sarah was professional and courteous, and answered all my questions during the estimate process. Devin and Chad were the installers, and did a fantastic job. They came earlier than expected and finished the job in a jiffy, and their work was first rate craftsmanship. I am more than pleased with Affordable Home AC.

affordable_home_ac.author: Rowel A.
affordable_home_ac.text: These people are awesome! Sarah was able to come to our home and give us quotes, and ended getting a new window AC installed in our bedroom. affordable_home_ac.author: Nancy T.

I would recommend this Company to anyone needing a window or wall air conditioned.

air_perfection.text:
We found Air Perfection (AP) to provide exceptional service at a reasonable price. AP installed 4 new Daikin split A/C's (9k, 2 x 12k, & 24k BTU units - 57,000 BTU total) for us in April 2023.

Air Perfection offers a 12 year warranty on Daikin equipment INCLUDING PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARDS (PCB's)! PCB's are VERY expensive (think $1,000 PLUS) and geckos / lizards love to hang out on the warm PCBs, often frying themselves and the PCB in the process. Air Perfection's 12 year warranty on Daikin extends to the PCBs and to gecko damage! We talked with several other AC suppliers and did not hear that from anyone else.

About a month after our A/Cs were installed and AP was paid, 2 of our A/C's quit working. The failure was tricky to troubleshoot, but AP sorted it out over the course of 3 visits. They did not drag their feet, they did not give us the run-around, they made appointments, gathered up the repair parts, sent out trained Techs and Electricians, and figured it out. Surprise - it turned out to be a small component on - you guessed it - the PCB of a multizone condenser (outside unit).

Also, we found AP to be very reliable. If they made an appointment for 8:00 AM, they showed up at 8:00 AM - consistently.

Rostin, Scott, Matt, Tai, Keani, and the rest of the AP crew responded promptly to our questions and concerns before and AFTER the sale. In our experience, you are unlikely to find a better AC provider.

BTW, we looked at Daikin, Fujitsu, and Mitsubishi. Mitsubishi was dramatically higher in price than Daikin, but that probably changes day to day.

Aloha,
Mark and Jeanne

And they had a blanket to cover the work area so it's clean and tidy. I hate when people wear shoes into my house. HATE! I'm so glad they were REAL professionals. Sometimes you worry with the price you pay. There would be cons cuz of that pro. But this was nothing but pros to everything. After they demo and I poured concrete. We lived without AC for 4 days IN EWA! Good thing no one died. Lol. But day 5. Concrete is dried enough to work on. Scott and Joe came 30 minutes early (730am). That means they'll finish earlier than expected. How awesome is that! Again, very clean and very professional about everything. They didn't have lunch and insisted to finish the work first. Then leave and go eat. But it's a 6 to 7 hour job. If something goes longer than expected. I'd feel bad. Cuz I'm hungry every 4 hrs... when I barely do much work. So I went to get them some food and had a cooler of drinks for them throughout the day. I know they appreciated that very much. Because they didn't eat until they were done. But sure enough everything was done before their estimated time for us. So awesome. I love how so efficient they were. Everyone will have a different outcome. But I can tell you my overall experience is really amazing. I'm sure if I ever have future problems. Which I cross my fingers I wont ever have. That they'll be on top of it to help me. Cuz I feel like after answering all my husband's questions. They're reliable.

Again I wanna give big thanks to Tai for the extra miles he's put out to help us. That's another story. But he really did.

Thank you Roston, Scott & Joe for demo day and installing them with such knowledge and efficiency and being completely respectful of our home. It's truly appreciated for sure.

I definitely recommend guys. I do. I read some reviews that looks bad. But honestly 2 sides to the story. I can only tell you my experience and I can assure you that I will always keep their contact and my first go to guys if anyone else ever needs AC work and help.

air_perfection.author: Justin M.
air_perfection.text:
This is THE ONLY COMPANY you need to call PERIOD!
Hardworking and Honest are two words that describe the owners. I've been looking for months at various companies to get estimates to install two Split AC systems for my house. Out of the 8+ estimates I got, Aire Dynamics came out on top... And by a fairly large margin I might add. Because this is a smaller company, they are able to give great pricing! Day of the install came and they came exactly at the time promised. Got straight to work... And both systems were installed that same day!!! Unreal Service and Professionalism!
Do yourself a favor... If you need to service your AC system or are looking for an estimate to install a system/s... Give them a shot... I promise you won't be disappointed!
Thanks for the system!! We are enjoying the nice and cold rooms!!

air_perfection.author: Common Sense C.
air_perfection.text:
We called Air Perfection based off the reviews we had seen here on Yelp. We were super nervous about inflated costs and other horror stories we had heard about other west side companies.
We called on Monday and Scott was able to come on Thursday. He arrived 30 minutes early and fixed two problems we were having in a short amount of time. He was pleasant and the cost was very reasonable.
We will definitely be calling Air Perfection again for any HVAC needs we might have.

air_perfection.author: Aaron S.
air_perfection.text: Keani, in sales, was very helpful in provide a quote and helping me understand what's included in their AC servicing, even going back to the techs for feedback. Pricing seemed quite reasonable.

air_perfection.author: Christina S.
air_perfection.text: Loved that they arrived early and focused on completing the work. We had them install a new AC and service/clean our existing ACs. The existing ACs run like they are brand new. They did an excellent job. Our existing ACs are Mitsubishis and the new one is a Fujitsu. Even though the unit is smaller, it does have a higher BTU than the one replaced and runs more efficiently and quietly. I would recommend this company to anyone who would like to install a new AC or service any existing ones.

air_perfection.author: Bruce B.
air_perfection.text:
Got my AC system installed on Monday 7/29/19 took them less than 7 hours for the whole job.
AND A GREAT JOB THEY DID.
The guys Scott, David and Crys did an excellent job very professional and extremely pleasant folks.
I highly recommend Air Perfection if you need your A.C. repaired or replaced.Give Tina a call and she will set you up .

air_perfection.author: Corey A.
air_perfection.text: I requested a quote thru Yelp and received an immediate answer, and after a quick and easy followup they called me to schedule an appointment a couple days out. The tech came promptly and serviced my 2 split AC units so that they are working 100% again! Very happy with the responsive customer service, and reasonable pricing. Definitely recommend!

air_perfection.author: Cheryl A.
air_perfection.text: These guys are great. Average$ for service. I've used them yearly for my central air service/ maintenance. Don't worry, I asked why the name change, don't remember exactly now but it was nothing sketchy. air_perfection.author: Keala G.
air_perfection.text: Scott arrived on time. He was knowledgeable and professional. He executed the job as requested. Very happy with the results. Will definitely hire for future a/c services.

air_perfection.author: Girlie C.
air_perfection.text: I forgot to give my review after my install 2yrs ago. The install was great, all technicians on deck. Everything was installed and blowing cold air within hours. They accommodated the install date around my move-in day which was a BIG PLUS for our pets. They even upgraded one of my units to \"the Cadillac\" because they didn't have 2 Fujitsu units in stock. So now, 2 yrs later, both Fujitsu and Mitsubishi units are working perfectly. I spray down the units outside and clean the filters monthly. I was recommended by my realtor. I highly recommend Air perfection.

air_perfection.author: Win N.
air_perfection.text:
I've had Air Perfection come out twice to service our split units. Between the two times, we had Scott, Mark, and Dylan come and work on our units. All three were very professional, and knew what they were doing. I've also spoken with Tina (office manager), regarding any questions and concerns. She answered all my questions, and help get the technicians out to our home in a timely manner.
My only wish is that I had knew about Air Perfection sooner. It would have saved me the hassle of working with other companies that did not do their jobs correctly.
I have already referred Air Perfection to my neighbors and parents. I will definitely continue using Air Perfection to service our home and business in the future.

air_perfection.author: J F.
air_perfection.text: Rostin (owner) is super nice and incredibly knowledgeable in what he does. He really takes care of his customers (and potential future customers) as though they were family! Air Perfection is about \"helping\" people do what's best for their families and not about making money. I highly recommend Air Perfection!

air_perfection.author: Melissa F.
air_perfection.text: I must've called a half dozen A/C companies for a big leak that needed repair. Ann was the only one that returned my phone call! Start with Air Perfection in your search for a good company.

air_perfection.author: John Y.
air_perfection.text: Their name says it all. This group of friendly professionals came on time and worked diligently throughout the day, ensuring everything was clean and in good order before leaving. Even after spending a long day at our house, we overheard them laughing and joking with each other, a sign of true team spirit. Our home is nice and cool again, a welcome respite to the humid weather the last couple of months. We're very impressed with their work, reasonable prices and expertise. It's no wonder they're the preferred A/C contractor for Home Depot. I suggest calling them first for your air conditioning needs. Thank you, Air Perfection, you were awesome.

air_perfection.author: David C.
air_perfection.text: In 2012 Photonworks installed 39 solar panels on my roof and did a great job. When my wife and I went looking for AC recently, our first contact was with Photonworks. Today we had a 36,000 BTU Mitsubishi system installed to cool our downstairs. It is awesome, as was working with Tai Rasmussen and Photonworks/Air Dynamics AC. Sensei Electrical was here also and were just as great. After 39 solar panels and a 36,000 BTU AC system, I can vouch for the work and products of Photonworks Engineering.

air_perfection.author: Laura K.
air_perfection.text: This company goes above and beyond! Now days that is a diamond in the ruff! I am so blessed to have been referred to Air Perfection! Tina and her wonderful elf's are on Santa's amazing list! I will be telling everyone about them!

air_perfection.author: James H.
air_perfection.text: Great communication from the very beginning. Joe came by on time to check our property in order to provide an accurate quote. Thorough when answering our questions as well. Price came back very competitive. Although the start date was pushed back due to supply issues (not their fault), they were good at keeping me updated. air_perfection.author: Russell J.

air_perfection.author: Shayla D.
air_perfection.text: Can't say enough good things about this company. I've use them for annual service as well as emergencies and they always provide outstanding customer service and quality at reasonable prices.

air_perfection.author: Carlin Y.
air_perfection.text: Definitely call Air Perfection. They put in a split AC at my office, than at my home. They used drop cloths and did the install as if it was their own home, making all the little things awesome! Thank you again Rostin and crew.

air_perfection.author: Lisa H.
air_perfection.text:
When we called for an appointment they got back to us right away unlike other companies we have dealt with in the past. They booked our appt and came on the set date a little early in fact which was okay by us.
Scott the tech was at our house for 4.5 hrs cleaning our 3 units snd compressor. He was friendly, polite, and neat. He worked nonstop and answered all our questions. Their prices are really fair and good compared to other quotes we got from some other companies.
I would highly recommend them and will be using them again for our annual pm. We were so pleasantly surprised. I see why they have 5 stars! Keep up the good work!

air_perfection.author: Jennel S.
air_perfection.text:
Imagine, it's a Sunday night, your 2-year old split system (with no prior issues) randomly konks out and stops working, the very same week you're hosting a very large party. Quasi-panic mode. Its now two days later, Tuesday, split AC units are working properly, panic-mode gone - all thanks to the awesome and amazing team at Aire Dynamics!
There's something to be said when there is a level of compassion and empathy when providing professional service. Scott and Aire Dynamics went above and beyond, not only exercising their level of expertise, but their ability to operate their business with heart and aloha.
In Hawaii its common to know someone who knows someone that can help you out, but this was the very first time meeting and working with Scott (thank you Yelp reviews!), but made us feel like we were family. Aire Dynamics remedied our issue, but even if for some reason the ac couldn't have been repaired, I'd still rate five stars for their level of service and professionalism. Thank you Scott and the Aire Dynamics team.

air_perfection.author: Cathy K.
air_perfection.text:
Our split system was installed by a different AC vendor who we decided not to call because of our last experience with them when they came out to repair the master bedroom unit. So when we were looking for a new AC company we read the great reviews about Air Perfection and our next door neighbor, who also used them, had only positive things to say. So, we took a chance and are glad we did.
Our master bedroom Mitsubishi split system was leaking water and the air felt really stale. Actually, the air had been stale for quite a few years, which we noticed even after we cleaned the filters monthly. Mark took one look at the unit, then to my horror showed me what was really causing the stale air... BLACK MOLD on the inside of the unit. Needless to say I was horrified that we were breathing that gross mold all these years. Mark suggested that I consider their Premium Maintenance which entailed taking the unit apart, thoroughly cleaning and removing the mold, flushing the drain line and checking the compressor. I agreed immediately and asked him to check the other 3 units in the house. Turned out that only 1 out of the 3 other split systems had the same black mold. So, I had him and Dylan work on all of them. I cannot say enough about how AWESOME these two men are. They were thoroughly professional in making sure that the work area was covered, they cleaned up after they finished and they took all my units apart and put them back together leaving them looking like they were brand new. The units are blowing cool again and most of all the air feels so clean! We will definitely be asking Air Perfection to come back again next year to inspect our units and maintain them. THANK YOU AIR PERFECTION!

air_perfection.author: Shar F.
air_perfection.text: What a great local company! These guys are very professional, accommodating and affordable. Clear and open communication all through the process from estimation to completion. This crew is very coordinated and it doesn't matter if you speak to Kai, Scott, Rostin, Ty, Alan, BJ, Mark... the list could go forever, they all are on the same page. What a well oiled machine they've got here. They also clean up after they've finished installation. We had a little issue with the drainage of the units and there was no problem with them coming back and fixing it in less than 20 minutes. Overall great experience and highly recommend them for all your AC needs.

air_perfection.author: Andrea K.
air_perfection.text: I recently hired Air Perfection to conduct maintenance on my split AC. Technician showed up on time. Scott was presentable and very professional. I appreciated everything he did considering it was a warmer day than usual. My split AC works so much better now that it's clean. I appreciate the hard work and the professionalism this company presents. I will definitely continue to hire them in the future.

air_perfection.author: Lora M.

air_perfection.author: Dexter M.
air_perfection.text:
Aire Dynamics will have to be your HVAC/R company to call for all your service and repair needs!! First of all, communication on Yelp was as easy as texting. Rostin's quick response won the bid for servicing my central AC in Ewa Beach. Booking was simple and through Yelp messaging, I was booked within minutes, even when communication was after normal working hours. I really needed someone to chemically treat the evaporator coil in the attic and clean and flush the condensate drain due to overflow from the drain pan out through the tell tale drain line.
On the scheduled day, Juvonny showed up right on schedule, assessed what needed to be done based on the Yelp quote I asked, and went straight to work. While he was working, I was completing some paperwork and on the phone with work while Juvonny continued pressing on and I almost forgot he was around.
Now, the estimated time of the job that Roston quoted was 1.5 to 2 hours. Juvonny completed the job, cleaned up the area he was working, packed up his gear, and came back with the work invoice right at 1.5 hours. Talk about accurately estimating work duration!!
Juvonny then explained what was done to the evap coil as well as the drain line which are now both clean. He even cleaned the condenser coil and checked operation of the unit, as well as changed the air filter, just as Rostin had quoted.
Juvonny took "before" pictures and the only recommendation I have is for them to also take "after" pictures to show customers how good of a job these guys do!!
After taking story with Juvonny at the end of the service, I understand why such quality work is accomplished by this company. They are dedicated to customer service and satisfaction and don't let their young age fool you.....they have a lot of experience working for other companies in the past and servicing the hotels in Waikiki on a variety of HVAC equipment.
Anytime you need HVAC service, please call these guys....I'm calling them for periodic maintenance and future service if needed. Mahalo!!!!

air_perfection.author: Sher D.
air_perfection.text: I'm not sure what to say other than the guy was nice and maintained our a/c! Good experience and available when we needed him!

air_perfection.author: James B.
air_perfection.text: AirPerfection did a great job installing AC in our three bedrooms: two upstairs and one downstairs. The quote was done quickly, fair, and the work was scheduled to meet our needs.

air_perfection.author: Kat V.
air_perfection.text: We moved in to our first home several months ago and one evening our Fujitsu air condition system stop working. The system showed a 99 blinker. The representive on the phone she is super sweet, caring, energetic, and informative. She set us up with Mark. Let me tell you, Mark is gawd-dang sent from heaven! Mark is timely and even took the time to answer our questions. The price for the work is very reasonable and the quality of work is super awesome. Yes, people, this is a gawd-dang real review and we are happy with the service. To Air Perfection, thank you again!

air_perfection.author: Rusty L.
air_perfection.text: From making an appointment for an estimate to replace an aging split system, to scheduling the work and then installation, all was done efficiently and professionally. My experience with this organization could not have been better!

air_perfection.author: Kainoa T.
air_perfection.text: I am a property manager with Century 21. It is so easy to schedule with this company and they are VERY professional. They are my first choice when it comes to AC repair and service. Thanks guys! Keep up the good work

air_perfection.author: Michael G.
air_perfection.text: Scott was very professional. He arrived early and walked me through all the work to be completed. He completed all the work in a timely manner and covered the furniture while performing the work. I would have them return for future service.

air_perfection.author: Shelley E.
air_perfection.text:
Seriously....who in their right mind can stand to live in Hawaii with AC?? Not THIS girl! No Way!
When I noticed my AC was dripping water like crazy and not blowing air I immediately freaked out and started calling all the YELP AC companies I could find....
I called all the "top rated" on yelp and NOT one of them answered their phone and only 1 called me back a day later.
Not giving up I kept going down the list till I hit Aire Dynamics, although they didn't answer I got a call back almost immediately. Rostin the owner called me back and I explained my situation. He was just finishing up a job and headed to another one but had some time between the 2 and offered to do they service on his way. It was awesome that he was willing to take a look even knowing he may not be able to repair it in the time frame.
They made it over in about 30 minutes, quickly disassembled my Fujitsu split air conditioner and went to work. Fortunately, all it needed was a bit of maintenance which he said I should do annually. They were SO friendly and so fast I was just completely amazed. AC is running great and blowing super cold air, just in time for these muggy storm months ahead!!!
Right on guys! So happy and lucky I found you and that none of those other dodo companies called me. I doubt I would have received the same level of service at such an amazing price!

air_perfection.author: Anna F.

Mahalo!

MANOA

Jeovanni went into the attic and checked the system and pipes to ensure all was running properly, very thorough and professional!!
We liked the service so much that we are setting up yearly Maintance with AIre Dynamics!!
Thank you again Raustin and Jeovanni!!
Great customer service all around!!!
Teresa
